setup.description: Two pledges and a few choices. You can change the choices later in Profile and privacy.

humanAuthorship.title: Human Authorship pledge
humanAuthorship.body: Creative work submitted to Society programmes (Waraq, the Prizes, Scratch Night, the Typewriter Tour) must be the member’s own. Work drafted, written, translated or generated by AI is not eligible. Spellcheck and basic grammar tools are fine. (Policy Manual, SAL-POL-01, P10.1)
humanAuthorship.accept: I make the Human Authorship pledge

member.title: Member Pledge (SAL-POL-01)
member.body: As a member of the Society of Arts and Letters, I will treat everyone with courtesy and every piece of work with care. I will critique the work and never the person. I will respect consent, before a camera and on the page. I will be honest with the Society’s money and its members’ trust. I will keep what is confidential, keep my word or say early that I cannot, and leave every room better than I found it.

pipeline.title: Waraq: pipeline
pipeline.lede: The blind review of submissions, from intake to decision. Each person sees only their part: the Submissions Manager holds the key and never scores; readers and editors work from blind ids; author names appear only after a decision.
